ratio_lat: The SM frequency and measured frequency are distinct; Delta M_SM uses a 3x3 unitary tree-only CKM and HPQCD/FNAL-MILC; quoted CKM & other errors are enlarged additively on each side. No CKMfit that includes the data being tested.
mass_matching: A single massive EW-singlet vector, canonical real field, left b-s and one muon doublet. Tree/Wilson and leading-log matching, no mixing of other operators at target precision; alpha*C10 is fixed by matching the reference absolute decay normalization in HPQCD to the conventional low-energy Hamiltonian. Mass interval is assumed, not measured. Omitted orders are not included in experimental widths.
threshold_budget: Control contribution to phi from decay penguins, possible new hadronic decay effects, etc is optionally bounded by 0.02 rad. The cuts on real P are also separately tested without a phase calibration. Combining working boxes is not a significance.
